name: std::filesystem::directory_iterator::operator*, std::filesystem::directory_iterator::operator->
intro:
Accesses the pointed-to directory_entry.

The result of operator* or operator-> on the end iterator is undefined behavior.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
1) Value of the directory_entry referred to by this iterator.

2) Pointer to the directory_entry referred to by this iterator.

recommendedExamples.title: Related example: std::filesystem::begin(directory_iterator), std::filesystem::end(directory_iterator)
